# Time Strong Health™

> Time Strong Health™ (Time Strong Health LLC) is private-pay concierge in-home fitness and wellness for older adults, especially people living with Parkinson's Disease and other neurological movement challenges, and the people who care for them. One-on-one sessions take place in the client's home. There is no clinic or office to visit.

Time Strong Health provides wellness-based fitness and movement coaching focused on functional mobility and quality of life. It does not bill Medicare or insurance, and it is not providing medical care. The founder is Hector A. Mallar, DPT, CSFS. He has over 15 years of experience with older adults and movement challenges, including specialist certifications in senior fitness and fall prevention.

Tagline: Promoting the kind of Health that keeps you Strong until the end of Time.

## Services

- [In-home fitness and wellness](https://www.timestronghealth.com/): Private-pay, one-on-one fitness and wellness in the client's home for older adults living with Parkinson's Disease and other neurological movement challenges, and for the people who care for them.
- [Programs](https://www.timestronghealth.com/#programs): Balance and fall-risk reduction; caregiver education in the home or online; in-home functional fitness for daily-living movements; and strength and mobility programming that adapts to goals and abilities.
- [Who we serve](https://www.timestronghealth.com/#who-we-serve): Fitness for individuals with Parkinson's and movement challenges, practical education for caregivers, and a provider information packet for referring physicians.
- [About the approach](https://www.timestronghealth.com/about): Personalized progressive fitness for functional mobility, strength and resilience, balance and fall-risk reduction, and long-term independence. Sessions are in the client's home: no gym, no travel, and no waiting room. Clients should have medical clearance for exercise when appropriate.
- [Founder](https://www.timestronghealth.com/#founder): Hector A. Mallar, DPT, CSFS, founder of Time Strong Health™.

## Service areas

- [Buckhead, Midtown, Sandy Springs, and Woodstock](https://www.timestronghealth.com/): Current in-home service area in metro Atlanta. Sessions are held in the client's home.
- [Athens, Oconee County, and Jackson County](https://www.timestronghealth.com/athens): Coming February 2027. Time Strong Health™ is partnering with Athens Personal Fitness to provide concierge in-home fitness and wellness for older adults in Athens, GA and nearby Oconee and Jackson counties.

## Book and contact

- [Contact and consultation](https://www.timestronghealth.com/contact): Call or text 404-458-7169, email info@timestronghealth.com, or send a message with your name, email, and a brief note. Replies are typically within 24–48 hours.
- [Athens interest list](https://www.timestronghealth.com/athens): Join for yourself, for someone you love, or as a referring clinician. Time Strong Health will reach out before February 2027. A doctor's referral with medical clearance, or a completed PAR-Q+, is required. Call 404-458-7169 with questions.
